en.html:
I took a neat one. A convenient size; somebody seemed to have considered the matter of fitting it into a mouth.

I ate.

...Salt, exactly right.

en.html: Fuki swayed. Perhaps my imagination, but stars seemed to be scattering inside her eyes.
